# `morphir package registry prepare`

- **Usage:** `morphir package registry prepare <FLAGS>`

Prepare an unsigned successor against the exact current view

## Flags
- **`--bundle <DIR>`** — Verified Library bundle from package create
- **`--release <DIR>`** — Signed Library release from package sign
- **`--policy <FILE>`** — Trust policy used when initializing the registry
- **`--registry <DIR>`** — Existing local registry directory
- **`--publisher-state <DIR>`** — Existing private publisher-state directory
- **`--expires <TIMESTAMP>`** — Expiry for newly signed metadata, as an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp
- **`--output <DIR>`** — New directory for draft.json and predecessor.json
- **`--json`**
